notes.title: English language mode not starting issue resolved
notes.notes: Sorry for the English mode launch issue. We have implemented a fix so that the English mode will launch properly.

notes.title: Game system updates
notes.notes:
Hello, thank you very much for trying out our new quirky little game. We have added a full screen mode to the game by double clicking the game window. You can exit out of the full screen mode by double clicking the screen again.

We have also implemented improvements, so GPU usage for RTX2080 won't be as high.

Please let us know if you encounter any issues. Thank you.
